profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Software engineering manager with over 20 years of experience working in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including leadership in design and development phases.  Performed important roles in ten different programs for multiple agencies.  Especially interested in image recognition and optics.

Clearances: Active TS/SCI w/SSBI, more.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led development of Azure Stack Edge solution accelerators integrating drones, HoloLens AR, and AI computer vision using C#/Unity, Python, Java, and YOLO; delivered custom prototypes in as little as six weeks.

Managed an automated cable validation initiative, reducing validation time by over 90% and accelerating data center build-out velocity.

Developed security-critical software in C# to isolate newly connected devices from the network, restricting access solely to attestation systems. Ensured strict access control and enhanced network integrity in high-assurance environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Patented a GPS-based frame-skipping system that reduced image capture by up to 99%, enabling photogrammetry on significantly lower-spec hardware.

Presented at trade shows and produced promotional videos (scripted, filmed, edited), helping grow the business line to seven partners across diverse markets.

Mentored an intern on a holographic 3D project using Azure Spatial Anchors, contributing reusable components that accelerated development across related systems.

Served as a board member for the design and construction of the Garage makerspace; designed Microsoft’s first indoor drone flight space and a dedicated video studio.

Piloted drones for partner demonstrations and corporate media, leveraging FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot certification to ensure regulatory compliance and safety.

positions.title: SME Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a unified web application using Angular, Java, and AWS RDS to integrate multiple data sources, streamlining analyst workflows.

Designed interactive visualizations to correlate and distill complex datasets, and built a collaborative interface to support real-time data sharing among users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Transformed agency from role-based to fine-grained attribute-based access control. Served as board member to provide COTS software guidance and participated in vendor market survey for core product replacement. Led development on full-stack web application in Java and AngularJS with Bootstrap for testing, policy creation, and demonstrations. Created critical, highly-available access-control system running on AWS EC2 and using DynamoDB, and S3.

Provided major release demonstrations for large audiences including high-ranking government customers.  Related new functionality with requirements satisfaction.  Briefed audience on use of system.

Designed and developed interactive Web UIs using AngularJS, Bootstrap, Dojo, jQuery, as well as raw HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.  Implemented JPA (Hibernate) models to connect software to database and drastically reduced the time required to implement industry-standard CRUD functionality.  Created Spring RESTful Web services and DAOs to connect front- and back-end layers which provided consistent entry points and shielded other components from complex data processing.

Developed rich front-end GUI for government open-source news website using Agile methodologies.  Enhanced customer experience by implementing key features including dynamic drag-and-drop management and presentation of images, video, and formatted text.  Applied Prototype JavaScript framework, Scriptaculous libraries, and TinyMCE Web editor.

Developed back-end software (XSLT and Java) to transform proprietary data loaded from Oracle database to Pubs-XML standard format.  Saved hundreds of hours of work by integrating and leveraging Ruby code from a partner program.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a comprehensive software test plan for a real-time combat decision support system written in C++, ensuring system reliability and performance under mission-critical conditions.

Analyzed and recommended software requirements to align with operational needs and technical constraints.

Designed and led development of a core web service for a large-scale program, integrating with external web services, custom APIs, EJBs, and databases. Authored WSDL and XSD specifications to fulfill customer interface requirements and deliver a standardized external gateway into the ordering system.

Developed a reusable data and interface conversion utility using Java Reflection to streamline integration.

Developed train-management software in a real-time, safety-critical C++ environment, meeting all delivery milestones within an aggressive timeline. Ensured system reliability and responsiveness under stringent constraints.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered a GIS application using ArcIMS to unify commercial and government satellite imagery, significantly enhancing spatial data accessibility and analytical precision.

Led cross-functional coordination across cost accounting, data synchronization, database administration, and software development teams in three geographic regions to drive legacy system data migration. Developed Access tools and reports to automate tracking of database documentation progress, improving visibility and reporting efficiency.

Saved hundreds of hours of work by developing tools that created JMeter XML data and scripts to load-test systems. Improved acquisition accuracy and eliminated hundreds of man-hours of work by creating tools with VBA and PL/SQL to automate Access database documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-developed Web-based mapping software for major Federal Government program that consistently received 100% award fees.  Map software was based on COTS products including MapInfo MapXtreme and ESRI ArcIMS.  Thin-client system allowed faster, simpler deployment for use worldwide.

Wrote custom advanced geometric algorithms for visualization of data that was otherwise impossible with Oracle Spatial.  Refined code that improved performance seven-fold while also providing more visual detail.

Automated database operations by writing scripts for Oracle and DB2, improving deployment efficiency and data consistency.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States
positions.description:
Developed custom utilities to test and verify proprietary software, improving validation efficiency and reliability.

Led the design and implementation of a centralized Testing Center website to streamline test management and reporting.
